column3: MT 60:1–3; the following verses of this psalm are MT +2. NASB sets the title in braces, but this copy splits it into braces and parentheses. “You have broken out against us” is rendered “You have broken us.”
Close to the Hebrew; “repair its fractures” is rendered “Heal its breaches.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a hard thing” is rendered “hardship.”
“Because of the bow” is rendered “because of the truth,” reading a similar Hebrew word.
The written Hebrew has “answer me”; NASB follows the reading “answer us.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB begins a quotation of God's words that runs to verse 8.
Close to the Hebrew; “the protection of My head” is rendered “the helmet of My head,” and “commander's staff” as “scepter.”
Close to the Hebrew; “over Me shout” is rendered “Shout loud … because of Me!”
Close to the Hebrew; “a city of fortification” is rendered “the besieged city.”
Close to the Hebrew; “worthlessness” is rendered “in vain.”
